summary: Hawthorn Bancshares (HBI) filed an 8-K updating that it has received all required regulatory approvals and non-objections to acquire FSC Bancshares (FBI) under an April 29, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Reorganization. The transaction remains subject to FBI shareholder approval and other customary closing conditions, expected to close in Q3 2026. No price, premium, advisor, or break fee terms are disclosed. The filing marks a milestone in a bank M&A deal; watch for shareholder vote timing and any regulatory conditions that could delay close.
